# dagsterplus_user (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ organization member by email address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

output "alice_role" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_user.alice.role
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The user ID assigned by Dagster+.
- `is_scim_provisioned` (Boolean) Whether this user was provisioned through SCIM.
- `name` (String) The display name of the user.
- `picture` (String) URL to the user's profile picture.
- `role` (String) The organization-level role: VIEWER, EDITOR, ADMIN, or OWNER.
